description: This file defines the EntityJoinOperator class, which implements join operations (AND/OR) for entity conditions in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for SQL generation, condition evaluation, and validation.

classes.name: EntityJoinOperator
classes.description: Represents a join operator (AND/OR) for entity conditions, supporting SQL generation, condition evaluation, and validation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Generates SQL string for the join of two conditions, appending to the provided StringBuilder.

methods.name: addSqlValue (overloaded)
methods.description: Generates SQL string for a list of conditions, combining them with the join operator.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable (frozen) version of an EntityCondition.

methods.name: freeze (overloaded)
methods.description: Creates a frozen EntityCondition from two conditions.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates a frozen EntityCondition from a list of conditions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the join condition against an entity or a map, returning a Boolean.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if an entity matches the join condition.

methods.name: entityMatches (list)
methods.description: Checks if an entity matches a list of conditions.

methods.name: eval (with delegator and map)
methods.description: Evaluates the join condition against a map with a delegator.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Checks if a map matches the join condition.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Validates the SQL conditions for the join operator.

methods.name: validateSql (list)
methods.description: Validates a list of conditions for SQL compatibility.
